text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let me see… I believe I need to get off at the next station… And then I'll need to change to a different line… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text: "Now approaching the final stop. I repeat, the final stop. Please mind your footing when leaving the train."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, deary me! I didn't mean to ride the train this far…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm… If I take the next train, I should make it back in time for training…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, how perfect! Trainer will be most pleased if I bring a souvenir to the training session. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, Station Attendant. Do you happen to know where I might find a gift shop?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Bean buns steamed at hot springs, bath salts, yukata, and tofu skins… There are so many wonderful items to choose from…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I might not have much time to browse, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I must find a gift that reflects my gratitude for all the time and effort Trainer has devoted to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright is so particular about the gift that she ends up missing the training session entirely.
